reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing exported getScheduledAmount and routes the five inline midpoint computations (template engine, forecast, updateActions, posting, preview) through it.

duplication.why: Removes every duplicated midpoint expression; the range rule now exists only in getScheduledAmount.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, the module both server and client already import for scheduled amounts.

scope.why: Only the amount rule and its call sites change, plus focused tests; stale comments are trimmed with the code they described.

maintainability.why: A single, tested definition used by every server and client path makes the next rule change a one-line edit.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All amount sites now call getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: Duplicated midpoint blocks are removed, not reshaped.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount, now used by schedule-template.ts, forecast-schedules.ts, schedules/app.ts (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule), computeSchedulePreviewTransactions and the client components.
